rationale: RRC has gapped up 11.6% on 17x relative volume with no news catalyst visible, placing price at 82% of today's range near the session high after a strong morning run. The last 5 candles show a micro-distribution pattern — a push to 53.00 followed by a pullback to 52.80 — suggesting momentum is stalling but without a clear directional setup. With no fundamental catalyst to anchor a thesis and the stock already extended far from prior close, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear and the probability of a clean continuation or reversal is insufficient to justify entry.
